verdict.note: Steady-state repeat FULL rebuild at unchanged drift-index tip and unchanged governed sources: 1818/1994/2544 ms against the product's own 1500 ms budget — the budget warning fires on every single rebuild (6/6 rounds). Boards for rounds 1-5 are byte-identical (jsonSha a2d70a3763e3664b), so nothing about the answer changed between rebuilds; only the derivation was re-paid. Instrumented breakdown on the same corpus: the selector-anchor pass (freshness.ts:579-605) is 837-992 ms of that build, of which 471-590 ms is anchorHitExists git work over 1018 distinct selector queries re-asked every rebuild, plus ~360 ms re-resolving selectors against the working tree. Round 2's 38 s is unrelated load on a box at load-average 8.6.

Same harness and corpus as the fail reading, on the committed tree with a clean checkout. Steady-state repeat FULL rebuild at unchanged head: the product's own budget warning fires 0/5 times, against 6/6 before at 1818-2544 ms. Rounds 1-5 are byte-identical to each other (jsonSha db8d50ff0777accf), 242 nodes. The invariant behind it is pinned in freshness.test.ts rather than in milliseconds: a rebuild at an unchanged head spawns ZERO git children, read off the process table via a PATH shim, while the first sweep spawns many. End-to-end numbers include startBuild's deliberate one-turn producer deferral and are NOT the logged build time.

One process, two module graphs, A-B-A: pristine base code (retains nothing, so it IS the full recompute) vs the committed scoped code, alternating over one corpus state. Every sample is a real producer run; A1==A2 across two DIFFERENT tick contents proves both that the corpus held still and that the tick never enters the board. Result: 366376 bytes on both sides, 'nodes'/'identity'/'issuesStamp' all identical, non-vacuous (242 nodes, 181 with an eval summary, 20 with overlays, 1090 verdicts resident). The only residue is evalSummary.epoch, a UUID minted per module instance — and the control, two BYTE-IDENTICAL copies of the base code, reproduces exactly that same difference with no code change at all. So the scoped board matches the recompute to precisely the degree identical code matches itself in this harness.
